Scoring multiple Direct Hits within 3? seconds of each causes the next Direct Hit to <solar/>Scorch the target.

Hit counter persists through stow.

<solar/>Scorch applied by Burning Ambition counts as Weapon Damage.

Direct Hits against <solar/>Scorched Enemies apply additional <solar/>Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown. (note: this part needs more testing)

<solar/>Ember of Ashes increases the amount of <solar/>Scorch applied by 50%.

Direct Hits against <solar/>Scorched Enemies apply additional <solar/>Scorch on a 0.5 second cooldown: 
• <primary/>Primary Weapons apply <pve 10 /> <pvp [4] /> additional <solar/>Scorch per Direct Hit (<pve 15 /> <pvp [9?] /> with <solar/>Ember of Ashes)
• <special/>Special and <heavy/>Power Weapons apply 20 additional <solar/>Scorch (20 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes)
